statutes.title: Tax Rate on Taxable Income of Individuals
statutes.breadcrumbs: MCL > Chapter 206 > Act 281 of 1967 > Part 1 > Chapter 2 > § 206.51
text_en: Imposes a flat individual income tax rate of 4.25% on taxable net income in Michigan.
text_es: Impone una tasa uniforme de impuesto sobre ingresos individuales del 4.25% sobre el ingreso neto gravable en Michigan.
